//: postvec-server configuration, read by the packaged unit (--config /etc/postvec-server/config.json). Every key is optional and has a default; unknown keys are a hard error. Keys beginning with // are comments. Precedence: defaults < this file < environment < flags. Every key, explained: /usr/share/doc/postvec-server/postvec-server.example.json
//peers: Bare hosts of the other nodes in this fleet, e.g. ["10.0.0.11", "10.0.0.12"]. Leave empty for a single node.
//managed: Optional database workers. See /docs/server/managed. Password files must be owned/readable by postvec-server, mode 0600. Use direct PostgreSQL endpoints, not transaction poolers.
//ssl: Certificate pair for the discovery listener. The unit runs as postvec-server with /opt/postvec root-owned and read-only, so the pair lives here: install the key as root:postvec-server mode 0640. Without a readable pair the node refuses to start. Set "insecure": true only for local development.
